short: DEX aggregator that splits trades across multiple liquidity sources for optimal execution
introduction: 1inch is a leading DEX aggregation protocol that finds the most efficient swap routes across multiple decentralized exchanges. By splitting a single trade across different liquidity sources such as Uniswap, Curve, Balancer, and others, 1inch achieves better prices than any single DEX could offer. The protocol also supports limit orders and its own Fusion mode for gasless swaps.
designPurpose: 1inch was designed to solve the liquidity fragmentation problem in DeFi, where optimal trade execution requires checking prices across dozens of DEXs simultaneously. The Pathfinder algorithm discovers complex multi-hop and split routes that minimize slippage and maximize output for the trader. This aggregation layer abstracts away the complexity of interacting with individual protocols.
commonUsage: Traders use 1inch to get the best possible price for token swaps, especially for large trades where splitting across multiple DEXs significantly reduces price impact. Protocols integrate the 1inch API to offer users optimized swap execution within their own interfaces. The limit order protocol allows users to place orders that are filled by resolvers when market conditions are met.
fn.swap.desc: Executes an aggregated swap through the specified executor contract, routing funds across multiple DEXs according to the pre-computed optimal path.
fn.swap.params.executor: The address of the aggregation executor contract that will perform the swap routing.
fn.swap.params.srcToken: The address of the input token to sell.
fn.swap.params.dstToken: The address of the output token to buy.
fn.swap.params.amount: The amount of the source token to swap.
fn.swap.params.minReturnAmount: The minimum amount of the destination token to receive. Reverts if not met.
fn.swap.params.data: Encoded swap route data generated by the Pathfinder off-chain algorithm.
fn.swap.returns.returnAmount: The actual amount of destination tokens received.
fn.swap.returns.spentAmount: The actual amount of source tokens consumed.
fn.unoswap.desc: Performs a simple swap through a single DEX pool. More gas-efficient than the full swap function for straightforward single-hop trades.
fn.unoswap.params.srcToken: The address of the source token to swap.
fn.unoswap.params.amount: The amount of the source token to swap.
fn.unoswap.params.minReturn: The minimum amount of output tokens to receive.
fn.unoswap.params.pools: Encoded pool addresses and flags for the swap route.
fn.unoswap.returns.returnAmount: The actual amount of output tokens received.
fn.fillOrder.desc: Fills a limit order by matching a taker with a maker's signed off-chain order. Supports partial fills and custom interactions.
fn.fillOrder.params.order: The signed limit order struct containing maker, taker tokens, amounts, and conditions.
fn.fillOrder.params.signature: The EIP-712 signature of the order from the maker.
fn.fillOrder.params.interaction: Optional calldata for custom interactions to execute during the fill.
fn.fillOrder.params.makingAmount: The amount of maker tokens to take in this fill.
fn.fillOrder.params.takingAmount: The amount of taker tokens to provide in this fill.
fn.fillOrder.params.skipPermitAndThresho: Flags to skip permit calls and set a threshold for minimum fill amount.
fn.fillOrder.returns.actualMakingAmount: The actual amount of maker tokens transferred.
fn.fillOrder.returns.actualTakingAmount: The actual amount of taker tokens transferred.
fn.fillOrder.returns.orderHash: The EIP-712 hash of the filled order.
fn.RemainingInvalidated.desc: Emitted when a limit order's remaining fillable amount is invalidated (cancelled) by the maker.
fn.RemainingInvalidated.params.maker: The address of the order maker who cancelled.
fn.RemainingInvalidated.params.orderHash: The hash of the invalidated order.
sim.aggregatedSwap.name: Aggregated Multi-DEX Swap
sim.aggregatedSwap.desc: Simulates an aggregated swap of WETH to USDC, split across multiple DEXs to achieve a better price than any single source.
sim.aggregatedSwap.step.pathfinderQuery: The Pathfinder algorithm queries prices across all supported DEXs and computes the optimal split routing strategy for the trade size.
sim.aggregatedSwap.step.splitRoutes: The Aggregation Router splits the input across multiple DEXs: 60% to Uniswap V3, 25% to Curve, and 15% to Balancer.
sim.aggregatedSwap.step.aggregateOutput: Each DEX executes its portion of the swap independently. The output tokens from all routes are collected at the router.
sim.aggregatedSwap.step.deliverOutput: The aggregated output tokens are transferred to the trader. The split routing yielded more tokens than any single DEX could provide.
